summary: Audited collision.py (761 lines) against Collision.md and PROJECT_CONTEXT.md §2.1/2.2. Found NO logic defects; made no edits. Verified: all geometry constants match (rim height 3.05, radius 0.225, centre (-0.375,3.05,0), rim-to-board 0.375; board 1.8x1.05 bottom 2.9 in x=0 plane; e=0.7 for BACKBOARD_RESTITUTION/RIM_RESTITUTION; TANGENTIAL_RETENTION=1.0). Backboard nearest-point-on-rectangle correctly clamps edge/corner for centres outside panel extent, detects both faces (incl. behind-plane overlap -> positive penetration), penetration = ball_radius - distance never negative. Rim uses distance-to-circle (not disc, not line segment); axis case correctly returns None (0.225 > 0.12). Normals always point surface->ball; degenerate zero-length normals use a stable non-NaN direction. reflect() flips only the normal component (tangential retention 1.0), normal speed ratio == e exactly, no energy gain (max 4.5e-13 over 200k oblique samples). restitution_for covers backboard+rim and raises on unknown. detect_any/detect_all are stable backboard-then-rim. Batch paths match scalar bitwise (0 mismatches over 5000 random points x 3 radii for backboard/rim/detect_all). 2D layer reproduces basketball_shot_2d.py inline math (hoop_geometry, board/rim bounce, scoring cross, classify/canonical). Verification: python test_collision.py 24/24 OK, python test_core.py 13/13 OK, python -m py_compile collision.py OK, python collision.py OK (exit 0). Trivial note (not fixed, cosmetic per rules): line 64 comment '# Geometry (metres) — 与 collision.py 完全一致' is a self-referential copy-paste artifact.
